component.name: Kerio VPN
component.summary: Desktop client for Kerio Control VPN on Linux

description.p: Kerio VPN is an open-source graphical client for the official Kerio Control VPN Client for Linux, which on its own only offers a command-line setup wizard.

ul.li: One-click connect and disconnect with multiple connection profiles
Live status, traffic chart, routes, DNS and latency
Split tunneling: bypass the VPN or force destinations through it
Kill switch, DNS leak protection and server certificate pinning
Live logs, diagnostics report, tray icon and a scriptable CLI

description.p: Kerio VPN is not affiliated with Kerio Technologies or GFI Software.
